newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU likely to appeal WTO meat hormone ruling.
newsitem.headline: EU likely to appeal WTO meat hormone ruling.

text.p: The European Commission is likely to appeal against a World Trade Organisation (WTO) dispute panel ruling that its ban on imports of hormone-treated meat breaks free trade rules, Commission officials said on Tuesday.
"The Commission considers that the matter must be brought before the appellate body of the WTO," the Commission said in a statement after the panel confirmed its initial finding.
But Commission officials said a formal decision to appeal could only be taken after member states had been consulted.
In its statement, the Commission said the panel had failed to take into account properly the scientific evidence presented by the EU in suport of its ban.

"They (the WTO panel) have ruled that no member...is allowed to establish its own level of protection. Our view is contrary to that," a Commission spokesman told a news briefing. "It's quite clear that there will be an appeal."
